title: Machine Learning Applications in the Solar Interior and Atmosphere
abstract: arXiv:2610.34687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The solar interior and atmosphere constitute a strongly coupled, multiscale dynamical system defined by continuous temporal evolution. Predicting the state of this system requires modeling physical interactions that span disparate spatial and temporal scales, constrained by heterogeneous and sparse data. This chapter formalizes the Sun within the mathematical framework of dynamical systems theory, defining a global state vector ($\vec{S}$) governed by thermodynamical, kinetic, and magnetic properties. Because solar observations represent projected, multi-modal, and partially observable measurements ($\vec{O}[\vec{S}]$) of this hidden state, pure physics-based deduction is fundamentally constrained. translated_title: 机器学习在太阳内部与大气中的应用
translated_abstract: 太阳内部和大气构成了一个强耦合的、多尺度的动力系统，具有连续的时间演化特征。预测该系统的状态需要对跨越不同空间和时间尺度的物理相互作用进行建模，同时受到异构且稀疏数据的约束。本章在动力系统理论的数学框架内对太阳进行形式化定义，给出了一个由热力学、动力学和磁学性质共同支配的全局状态向量（$\vec{S}$）。由于太阳观测本质上是对这一隐藏状态的投影式、多模态且部分可观测的测量（$\vec{O}[\vec{S}]$），纯物理演绎方法从根本上受到限制。我们提出了一个统一的核心论点：机器学习在太阳物理学中的主要作用是充当一个结构化的数学算子家族——具体包括推断、仿真、传播等算子。
tldr: 本章将太阳内部与大气形式化为一个强耦合多尺度动力系统，并提出机器学习在太阳物理学中的核心作用是充当推断、仿真、传播等结构化数学算子，用于从部分可观测的多模态数据中预测太阳系统的状态。
en_tdlr: This chapter formalizes the Sun's interior and atmosphere as a strongly coupled, multiscale dynamical system and proposes that machine learning's primary role in heliophysics is to act as a structured family of mathematical operators—Inference, Emulation, and Propagation—for predicting the solar system's state from partially observable, multi-modal data.
